A_now_watch_ordering.note: Strong fact → now action; weaker inference → watch. Deterministic ordering by priority.

insights.statement: The pricing page lists the current entry-plan price after the recent listing change.
Buyer attention to the entry price appears to be rising after the listing change.

expect.note: Fact-backed experiment scores now; low-impact investigate lands watch.

B_weak_cap.note: Weak single-source insight. Model proposes a strategic change → code cap rejects it; only a bounded experiment survives.

insights.statement: A single community post mentions a possible entry-offer tweak in the current window.

expect.note: Weak-signal policy (§18): change exceeds cap, experiment survives.

C_contradiction_segments.note: Contradictory insights for two segments produce opposed actions that are classified segment_specific — never auto-resolved.

insights.statement: Standard-tier buyers show mixed reactions to the current price rather than a uniform view.
Premium-tier buyers show the opposite mixed reactions to the current price.

expect.note: Both sides kept; conflict_group_id wired to both diagnostics.

D_semantic_dedup.note: Two near-identical entry-offer experiments → one deterministic winner; loser recorded on the winner's diagnostics.

insights.statement: The pricing page lists the entry plan at the current monthly price.

expect.note: Equal priority/confidence → §28 tie-break: shorter action wins.

E_specificity_guard.note: Model invents an ungrounded budget and an ungrounded persona → both rejected; only the grounded candidate survives.

insights.statement: The pricing page lists the Team plan at its current monthly price.

expect.note: §33: money and persona specificity must be grounded in the cited evidence pool.

F_jp_bilingual.note: EN + JA evidence feed one cross-source signal; the recommendation grounds Japanese wording in the cited JA evidence.

insights.statement: An official Japanese blog post reports improved Japanese translation quality in the meeting tool.
Meeting-tool translation quality appears to be gaining attention as a competitive dimension.

expect.note: Bilingual golden: JA evidence reaches the support chain and its wording grounds the recommendation statement.
